rejected.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: Zero hidden reasoning tokens and 2.1s latency made it the obvious cheap cross-family judge, but 40% order-flip consistency and a 75% A-rate mean it reads position more than chemistry.
rejected.gemini-3.8-flash-high as judge: Most order-robust of the three (90%), but 2869 hidden reasoning tokens per call, 4.5x gemini-3.7 and more total tokens than gpt-5.6-luna. Assigned to generation instead.
rejected.gpt-5.4-mini: 4160 hidden reasoning tokens and 61s latency; the most expensive and slowest candidate tested.
